description: This file defines the class JsonObjectInjectAdapter, which serves as an adapter implementing the io.opentracing.propagation.TextMap interface to inject tracing properties into a JSON object within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: JsonObjectInjectAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class implementing TextMap interface to inject tracing data into a JSON object.

methods.name: JsonObjectInjectAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a JsonObject, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the entries, but is unsupported and throws an exception.

methods.description: Puts a key-value pair into the JSON object, used for injecting tracing information.
